in_sanskrit.name: Ayanraj
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who reigns with a radiant or shining presence

in_marathi.name: Ayanraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayanraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Ayan (ruler, lord) and Raj (jewel, king). This name evokes images of a powerful and regal leader who is also rich and precious.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Jewel ruler
